column1: # runtime_defers.tsv — the per-file ledger of DEFERRED compilation failures
# (runtime_defer_ledger_test.go; the maintainer's call, 2026-09-24).
# One line per lang/spec file that has rows which COMPILE and then BAIL —
# the compiled run dying with the compiler-defect note: the VM abandoning
# the run at a designed defer site (vmDefer, its site named below) or
# raising an internal error the compiler admitted at compile time:
#   <spec file> TAB <bailing rows> TAB <what moved it>
# sorted by file name; a file not listed has none. TestSpecCompiledOrFallback
# asserts every line against the live count of every file the run walks —
# under BORU_SPEC_FILES too, so a filtered run over one family catches a new
# deferral in that family in seconds. The corpus-wide "runtime defers" gate
# (engine_entry_census_test.go) counts defer EVENTS by site; the walk's
# bailDefectCeiling (compiled_defect_test.go) is the sum of the second
# column; this ledger names the ROWS by file.
# Every count is a RATCHET ON A DEFECT COUNT, never a budget: a row that
# compiles and then bails is a defect the compiler admitted after the fact,
# not a decision it made. A line moves DOWN with the change that runs its
# rows natively (deleted at zero), and UP only with the rows that moved it
# named in the third column — a deferral booked by choice (the maintainer's,
# where a compile-time decline would be over-wide) or a regression, and the
# column says which. Lowering a line by deleting a corpus row is not
# allowed. Nothing regenerates this file: edit it by hand, in the change
# that moved it.
# First written 2026-09-24 from the walk's standing bails (52 rows) plus the
# two rows booked by choice that day (fn-value.tsv L317/L318, NUR190's `/q`
# capture deferred at the landing's walk).
# fold-map-filter.tsv left the ledger on 2026-09-25: L246–L248, fold/each/
# scan over a class member's Any-typed list, run natively through the
# dyn-body poly re-match the recovery now records (widest satisfiable
# overload) instead of bailing at the rematch trap.
# fnpred.tsv left the ledger on 2026-09-25 (NUR141, the check pass runs a
# PURE predicate over a concrete candidate): L34, L38, L43, L46 — `def
# q:Even 5` and its twins — are the static check error the run raised, so
# the program never runs compiled; record.tsv's L178 went the same way.
# fn-value.tsv left the ledger on 2026-09-26 (NUR190 closed): L317/L318,
# `m.f z` and `m get 'f' z`, take the landing's island — the value and the
# program from the word on run on the interpreter, which captures the word
# — where the landing deferred.
